subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Distinctive
solution:
The correct answer is '**Common**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Distinctive**' is '**Common**'.
 
• **Distinctive**: clearly different from others and therefore easy to recognize. (सबसे स्‍पष्‍टतया अलग और सरलता से पहचान में आने वाला, भेदकारी)
 
 
• *Example: The soldiers were wearing their **distinctive** red berets.*
 
 
 
• **Common**: occurring, found, or done often; prevalent. (घटित होना, पाया जाना, या अक्सर किया जाना; प्रचलित।)
 
 
• *Example: *"salt and pepper are the two most **common **seasonings"
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** common *.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Similarity**: the state of being like somebody/something but not exactly the same. [किसी के समान या सदृश (परंतु पूर्णतः वही न) होने की सि्‍थति; समानता, सादृश्‍य]
 
• **Close**: only a short distance away or apart in space or time. (समीप)
 
• **Original**: first; earliest (before any changes or developments). [(किसी परिवर्तन या विकास से पूर्व) प्रथम; आदिम; मूल]
